test.description: Run the full Vitest suite for Express and Kysely, and suggest fixes if any tests fail.
test.template:
Please run the full Vitest test suite for this Express.js and Kysely application.

1. Execute Tests: Run the complete test suite (using `npm test`).
2. Analyze Failures: If any tests fail, carefully examine the test logs, stack traces, and relevant Express routes or Kysely database queries/migrations/seeds.
3. Suggest & Apply Fixes: Root-cause the failing assertions and provide precise fixes or code patches to resolve them.
